row.evidence: Workday publishes no pricing ("Speak with one of our experts to learn more about pricing") and no inbound SCIM service: its public REST and SOAP (WWS) directories list no SCIM endpoint, and Microsoft's Workday apps pull workers from Workday and only write back email, username and phone.
row.notes: Status changed from June (gated) to none under rule 3a/3b: Workday HCM is the HR source of truth. IdPs read workers from Workday (Entra inbound provisioning via the Workday Human Resources API; Okta's Workday app is HR-sourced with attribute writeback) and can only write back work email, username and phone (Entra Workday Writeback over Workday Web Services, SOAP). No SCIM endpoint into Workday is documented: the public REST API directory (community.workday.com restapi, service list read from its bundle: absenceManagement ... wql, no SCIM service) and the WWS SOAP directory have none. June's claims (SCIM on Enterprise tier, 'SSO must be configured first (otherwise 403)', '~$35-$100 PEPM') have no first-party source and are dropped; June's pricing URL (workday.com/en-us/pricing.html) now returns 404, replaced by the midsize-business page. Workday accounts can be managed over WWS SOAP (Add/Get/Update_Workday_Account, user-based security group assignment) by an Integration System User. Suite products (Adaptive Planning, Peakon, Strategic Sourcing) were not researched.

okta.notes: OIN markup checks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Attribute Sourcing, Schema Discovery and Attribute Writeback: an HR-sourced import into Okta with writeback, not provisioning into Workday.

entra.notes: Separate gallery apps: Workday (SAML SSO), Workday to AD/Entra inbound (HR source) and Workday Writeback (email, username, phone via WWS).

fallbacks.other_sync: Outbound/HR-driven: Entra and Okta import workers from Workday; Entra Workday Writeback updates work email, username and phone over Workday Web Services (SOAP).
fallbacks.notes: Admin and integration docs (doc.workday.com, Community) require a customer login; only the API directories are public.

open_questions: Workday's admin documentation is behind a customer login, so a private SCIM option cannot be ruled out (June row claimed one).
Which Workday subscriptions include SAML SSO is not public (Entra tutorial only says an 'SSO enabled subscription').
Workday suite products (Adaptive Planning, Peakon Employee Voice, Strategic Sourcing) may offer their own SCIM and were not researched.
